source: If 32 query heads each own distinct K/V heads, the cache contains 32 K heads and 32 V heads per token. If the same 32 query heads share only 8 K/V heads, the persistent cache payload is one quarter as large. If all 32 queries share one K/V head, it is one thirty-second as large as the ZXNAME0000XZ cache under the sameZXMATH0000XZ assumptions.
zh: 如果 32 个查询头各自拥有不同的 K/V 头，则缓存包含每个令牌 32 K 头和 32 V 头。如果相同的 32 个查询头仅共享 8 K/V 头，则持久缓存有效负载将是四分之一。如果所有 32 个查询共享一个 K/V 头，则在相同的 ZXMATH0000XZ 假设下，它的大小相当于 ZXNAME0000XZ 缓存的三十秒。
